major_issues: Mobile layout is overly tall and dense: the primary flow diagram becomes a thin, low-utility strip while the right-rail cards dominate; key content hierarchy is inverted on small screens.

Several long strings/URLs look at risk of overflow and poor wrapping (e.g., the http://127.0.0.1… line, long tags like "agave_preflight_not_green"); current styling relies on tiny text and may clip or force awkward line breaks on narrower devices.
Top control cluster (tabs + Fit + zoom controls) is cramped and hard to operate on mobile; small tap targets and tight spacing reduce usability.
medium_issues: Contrast/readability: many secondary labels use low-contrast gray on dark backgrounds; small font sizes plus blur/shadow effects reduce legibility.
Right sidebar cards have inconsistent internal spacing and hierarchy: headings, meta lines, and chips compete; too many similar-weight elements.
Event strip at bottom of the main panel is visually busy and may truncate important info; the left 'EVENT STRIP' label and timestamps compete with the message content.
Overall composition has heavy vignetting/blur behind panels; looks stylish but reduces perceived sharpness/polish and can make UI feel muddy.
minor_issues: Button styling inconsistency: 'UI review running' pill vs 'Run UI review loop' button vs small icon buttons feel like different systems.
Some labels appear truncated/abbreviated oddly on mobile tabs (e.g., "Economi"); suggests insufficient responsive tab handling.
Cards use large shadows/radii everywhere; the visual separation is strong but makes the UI feel heavier than necessary.

recommended_changes.change: Implement a real responsive layout: at <=768px, move the right-rail below the diagram, and constrain card heights with collapsible sections (e.g., accordion) so the diagram remains a primary, usable viewport. Use CSS grid/flex with explicit order changes and a sticky/compact header.

Harden overflow handling for long strings: apply `overflow-wrap:anywhere; word-break:break-word;` to descriptions/URLs; apply `max-width:100%` and `text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;` to single-line chips/metadata where appropriate. Ensure chips wrap with `flex-wrap:wrap` and consistent gaps.

Increase mobile tap targets and spacing for controls: set icon/button min-size to 36–44px, add padding/gap around the tab row and zoom controls, and allow the tab row to horizontally scroll (`overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;`) instead of truncating (fix "Economi").

Improve typography scale/contrast: bump base font on mobile (e.g., 14->15/16px), increase line-height for paragraphs, and raise secondary text contrast (lighter gray). Reduce excessive text-shadow/blur on the background to improve crispness.
Normalize card hierarchy: enforce consistent spacing tokens (e.g., 8/12/16px), make card titles clearly dominant, demote meta lines, and standardize chip styling (same height, padding, border).
Tune visual effects: reduce vignette intensity and shadow spread/opacity to make panels feel cleaner and less heavy, especially on mobile.
Optionally add 'Show more/less' toggles for verbose blocks (e.g., Local Agave description, Frontend review URL) on small screens to reduce scroll fatigue while keeping details discoverable.

stop_reason: Not production-worthy yet due to weak mobile information hierarchy and control usability, plus insufficient overflow handling for long strings leading to potential clipping/wrapping issues.
